drivingQuestion: Why must the mishna state that even one letter invalidates the tefillin passages?
outcomeNote: the redundancy challenge is answered in the next unit (menachot.sugya093)

segments.he: אַרְבַּע פָּרָשִׁיּוֹת שֶׁבַּתְּפִילִּין מְעַכְּבוֹת זוֹ אֶת זוֹ, וַאֲפִילּוּ כְּתָב אֶחָד מְעַכְּבָן. פְּשִׁיטָא!
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: With regard to «the four passages that are in the phylacteries,» i.e., the two passages that are written in the mezuza and two additional passages (Exodus 13:1–9, 11–16), the absence of «each prevents fulfillment of the mitzva with the others, and» the absence of «even one letter prevents fulfillment of the mitzva with» the rest of «them.» The Gemara asks: Isn’t it «obvious» that the inclusion of every letter is necessary?
